label: {{space}} memory
description: Shared memory: what this Space’s socios know for everyone who can read it. Approved by its editors.
load-failed: Could not load the Space’s memory.

audience.who: Everyone in the workspace reads this Space’s memory.
audience.who_private: This Space is private: only its people and workspace admins read its memory.
audience.use: Socios with this Space use matching entries in chats, and in a chat with other people only when every one of them can read it.
audience.waits: What you propose waits for its editors.
audience.waits_editor: Socios’ proposals wait for you or another editor.

entries.title: In use
entries.empty: Nothing yet. Propose a lasting team fact, convention or decision, like “Invoices go out on the 1st”, or ask a socio with this Space to propose one.

retired.title: Retired
retired.kept_one: Kept {{count, number}} day after they are retired, with earlier versions and proposals turned down.
retired.kept_other: Kept {{count, number}} days after they are retired, with earlier versions and proposals turned down.

retire-confirm.title: Retire this entry?
retire-confirm.body: Socios stop using it in every chat at once. Proposals waiting to change it are turned down. It stays under Retired until it is deleted.

delete-confirm.title: Delete this entry for good?
delete-confirm.body: Every version of it goes. Backups keep it until they age out.

editor.label: Entry
editor.note: It waits for one of the Space’s editors, and is used only once they approve it.
editor.note_now: It is in use as soon as you save: socios with this Space use it with everyone who can read it. The version before is kept in its history.
editor.rule: One lasting fact, convention or decision; nothing private about a person, and no secrets.

history.title: Entry history
history.description: Every version, newest first, with who proposed and approved it.
